shortDescription: NetApp ONTAP information gatherer using REST APIs

options.name: cert_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client cert file (.pem). not supported with python 2.6.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: fields
options.description: Request specific fields from subset. Recommended - '<list of fields>' to return specified fields, only one subset will be allowed. Discouraged - '*' to return all the fields, one or more subsets are allowed. This option can be used for discovery, but is discouraged in production. Stongly discouraged - '**' to return all the fields, one or more subsets are allowed. This option can put an extra load on the system and should not be used in production. Limited - '' to return default fields, generall

options.name: force_ontap_version
options.description: Override the cluster ONTAP version when using REST. The behavior is undefined if the version does not match the target cluster. This is provided as a work-around when the cluster version cannot be read because of permission issues. See https://github.com/ansible-collections/netapp.ontap/wiki/Known-issues. This should be in the form 9.10 or 9.10.1 with each element being an integer number.

options.name: gather_subset
options.description: When supplied, this argument will restrict the information collected to a given subset. Either the REST API or the ZAPI info name can be given. Possible values for this argument include application/applications or application_info application/consistency-groups application/consistency-groups/metrics B(Requires the owning_resource to be set) application/consistency-groups/snapshots B(Requires the owning_resource to be set) application/templates or application_template_info cloud/targets or cloud_

options.name: hal_linking
options.description: if false, HAL-encoded links are disabled in the REST calls.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the ONTAP instance.

options.name: http_port
options.description: Override the default port (80 or 443) with this port

options.name: https
options.description: Enable and disable https. Ignored when using REST as only https is supported. Ignored when using SSL certificate authentication as it requires SSL.

options.name: ignore_api_errors
options.description: List of substrings. If a substring is contained in an error message when fetching a subset, the module does not fail and the error is reported in the subset.

options.name: key_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client key file.

options.name: lambda_config
options.description: Configuration parameters for AWS Lambda proxy functionality. These option and suboptions are only supported with REST.

options.name: max_records
options.description: Maximum number of records returned in a single call.

options.name: owning_resource
options.description: Some resources cannot be accessed directly.  You need to select them based on the owner or parent.  For instance, volume for a snapshot. The following subsets require an owning resource, and the following suboptions when uuid is not present. <application/consistency-groups/metrics> B(cg_name) is the consistency group name, B(svm_name) is the owning vserver name for the consistency group. <application/consistency-groups/snapshots> B(cg_name) is the consistency group name, B(svm_name) is the ownin

options.name: parameters
options.description: Allows for any rest option to be passed in

options.name: password
options.description: Password for the specified user.

options.name: state
options.description: deprecated as of 21.1.0. this option was ignored and continues to be ignored.

options.name: use_lambda
options.description: Specifies if AWS Lambda proxy functionality should be used to connect to the ONTAP system. Supported only with REST.

options.name: use_python_keys
options.description: If true, I(/) in the returned dictionary keys are translated to I(_). It makes it possible to use a . notation when processing the output. For instance I(ontap_info["svm/svms"]) can be accessed as I(ontap_info.svm_svms).

options.name: use_rest
options.description: This module only supports REST. always -- will always use the REST API. A warning is issued if the module does not support REST.

options.name: username
options.description: This can be a Cluster-scoped or SVM-scoped account, depending on whether a Cluster-level or SVM-level API is required. For more information, please read the documentation U(https://docs.netapp.com/us-en/ontap/authentication/create-svm-user-accounts-task.html). Two authentication methods are supported 1. options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If set to C(no), the SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(False) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
